note: Entrance routes as stated in the SRM 2026-27 admission brochure. Programs offered may vary across campuses.
helpline_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (except public holidays)

routes.label: Engineering and Technology: B.Tech, integrated M.Tech
routes.steps: Take SRMJEEE B.Tech, then apply on the B.Tech form.

routes.label: Architecture: B.Arch, M.Arch
routes.steps: B.Arch uses NATA and M.Arch uses PGETA, per the brochure.

routes.label: Law: 5-year and 3-year programmes
routes.steps: SRMJEEL followed by a personal interview. CLAT scores are considered directly for the interview.

routes.label: Management: MBA
routes.steps: SRMJEEM followed by a personal interview. Scores in CAT, XAT, MAT, GMAT, NMAT, CMAT or TANCET are considered directly for the interview.

routes.label: Medicine and Dentistry: MBBS, BDS and postgraduate
routes.steps: Admission only through NEET eligibility and counselling by MCC of DGHS, Government of India.

routes.label: Health Sciences: allied health, pharmacy, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, nursing, public health
routes.exam: SRMJEEH (Health Science UG, PG or Post PG)
routes.steps: Take SRMJEEH for your level. Some programmes are merit-based on Physics, Chemistry and Biology marks.

routes.label: Science and Humanities, Agricultural Sciences, Hotel and Catering Management
routes.steps: The brochure does not state an entrance exam for these. Check SRM's website.
